text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Light gray finely striped stand-collar short sleeve shirt with rolled cuffs and short placket; charcoal pleated wide-leg trousers; black shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A black leather briefcase satchel with two buckled flap straps, top handle and long shoulder strap.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product image. Remove the entire black scarf AND black necktie from the shirt. Remove the added belt. Keep only the light gray stand collar shirt, charcoal trousers, black shoes and ONE black briefcase satchel. Preserve all other garment cuts, colors, textures and proportions. Keep pure white background, fully visible uncropped outfit and accessories, hollow empty garments without human body, skin or mannequin. Do not add anything.
